{{Out of date|date=June 2025|reason=Contains only statistics from 2010}}

The demographics of Aguascalientes are analysed and collected by the [[National Institute of Statistics and Geography|National Institute of Statistics and Geography (INEG)]]. As of 2010, the population of Aguascalientes is overwhelmingly ethnically [[Mexicans|Mexican]] and [[Catholic Church|Roman Catholic]]. The average life expectancy in 2011 was 75.8, which is slightly above the national average. The city's population is steadily increasing with a growth rate of 2.2%

In 2010, The religious demographics of '''[[Aguascalientes]]''' were:

* '''[[Evangelicalism|Evangelical]] [[Protestant]] &ndash;''' ''40,987''
* '''[[Roman Catholic]] &ndash;''' ''1,101,785''
* '''[[Jewish]] &ndash;''' ''113''
* '''Different from Evangelical Bibles &ndash;''' ''10,779''
* '''Unclaimed &ndash;''' ''21,235''
* '''Others &ndash;''' ''722''
* '''Unspecified &ndash;''' ''9,375''
